D: A young fox and a hound puppy become best friends before growing up on opposite sides.
P: Serve the snacks when Tod and Copper play by the creek.
S: Buttermilk scones with rubbed in butter, baked hot
Scones of self-raising flour, cold butter and buttermilk, cut into rounds and baked at 220C for 14 minutes, with butter and honey.
Blackberries and blueberries with honey and mint over whipped cream
Blackberries and blueberries tossed with honey and torn mint, spooned into cups over whipped cream.
Amos Slade and his hunting dogs

Beef topside sliced thin, marinated overnight in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and garlic, dried at 75C for 4 hours until chewy. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour so it slices easily, then cut across the grain into 3mm strips, trimming off fat. Mix 80ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp cracked black pepper. Marinate the beef overnight in the fridge. Pat dry, lay on wire racks over trays and dry at 75C for 4 hours with the oven door slightly open until chewy. Cool before serving.
M: Chicken thighs simmered with carrot and celery, parsley dumplings
Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and onion in stock, topped with herb dumplings and covered for the last 20 minutes.
Country beef pot roast and gravy
the farm on the edge of the forest

Beef chuck braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrots and potatoes in stock, gravy from the pot. Season a 1.5kg beef chuck roast and brown all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp tomato paste, a few thyme sprigs and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 4 carrots and 800g potatoes in big chunks and braise 1 hour more. Lift out the meat and veg, simmer the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water until it thickens to gravy, and pour over the sliced beef.
W: Blackberries under a drop scone topping
Blackberries tossed with sugar under a buttery cobbler topping, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, with vanilla ice cream.
K: Strawberries, vanilla ice cream, milk and honey blended frothy

Fresh strawberries blended with cold full cream milk, vanilla ice cream and honey until pink and frothy, poured into jars. Hull 250g strawberries and blend with 500ml cold full cream milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 1 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 glass jars and top each with a halved strawberry. Serve straight away.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Rub the cold butter into the flour and salt.
Stir in the buttermilk until just combined.
Pat out, cut into rounds and place on a tray.
Bake.
Serve warm with butter and honey.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Toss the berries with honey and torn mint.
Spoon cream into small cups and top with the berries.
Slice the carrots, celery and onion.
Simmer the chicken with the vegetables in the water.
Rub the butter into the flour, add parsley and enough water for a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls onto the stew, cover and cook.

veg.n: Farmhouse mushroom and butter bean dumplings

steps.text: Slice the carrots, celery and onion.
Soften the vegetables and mushrooms in 20 g of the butter.
Add the stock and butter beans and simmer.
Rub the remaining butter into the flour, add parsley and enough milk for a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls onto the stew, cover and cook.
Heat the oven to 180C. Toss the blackberries with sugar and spread in a dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, then add the milk to make a soft batter.
Drop rough spoonfuls over the fruit.
Bake.
Serve warm with ice cream.
Hull the strawberries.
Blend with the milk, ice cream, honey and vanilla until frothy.
Pour into four glass jars and top each with a halved strawberry.

s.note: Buttermilk scones with rubbed in butter, baked hot
s.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour with a pinch of salt. Stir in 300ml buttermilk until just combined. Pat out, cut into rounds and bake at 220C for 14 minutes. Serve warm with butter and honey.

s.note: Blackberries and blueberries with honey and mint over whipped cream
s.how: Toss 125g blackberries and 125g blueberries with a spoon of honey and torn mint. Spoon over whipped cream in small cups. A sweet snack for two friends playing by the creek.

m.note: Chicken thighs simmered with carrot and celery, parsley dumplings
m.how: Simmer 800g chicken thighs with sliced carrot, celery and onion in 1.5L water for 40 minutes. Rub butter into 200g self-raising flour, add chopped parsley and water to a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls on top, cover and cook 20 minutes.

w.note: Blackberries under a drop scone topping
w.how: Toss 500g blackberries with 80g sugar and spread in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 250g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop rough spoonfuls over the fruit. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Strawberries, vanilla ice cream, milk and honey blended frothy
d.how: Hull 250g strawberries and blend with 500ml cold full cream milk, 4 scoops vanilla ice cream, 1 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 glass jars and top each with a halved strawberry. Serve straight away.
